metric: result_seconds, cold and warm p50 and p95, over the serial control of the same run
confirmation_policy: Five candidate repetitions against the five fresh serial controls of the same run and the same source, repeated as whole rounds and read on the median. One round decides nothing here: the serial control's warm p95 moves by about a third with load outside the cgroup, and the floor divides by it.
estimator_note: Nearest-rank p95 of k observations is the ceil(0.95k)-th. A five-repeat serial control has k=5, so its p95 is its maximum; a three-session rung has k=15, so its p95 is also its maximum; four sessions has k=20 and excludes the maximum, five has k=25 and excludes one. The ladder is therefore not monotone -- three sessions is the harshest rung on it -- and this is retained rather than corrected.
original_source_note: origin/main already holds the held-open process of 48d1559. The retained 2026-09-10 qwen ratios divide by a 3e0e6ed control that started a CLI per turn -- warm p50 11.0 s against this control's 0.21 s -- so they do not read as this floor.
